Ontario Premier Doug Ford hints at Toronto mayoral endorsement

Ontario Premier Doug Ford has suggested he is backing a candidate in the Toronto mayoral race, stating that voters should 'read between the lines' when considering his public statements. While not explicitly naming a preferred candidate, Ford's comments have been interpreted by some media outlets as a veiled endorsement. The premier has not made a direct endorsement, leaving the specific candidate of his choice unclear.
